trade_rule: Existing same-direction positions: retain within relative band, otherwise trade to nearest edge. New entries, zero targets and sign changes execute at target. Hard risk and exposure limits override the band.
limit_timing: Monthly decision points, after beginning-of-month trading costs; capital and forecasts can change between rebalances. Proportional reductions only; do not enlarge positions to reach the risk ceiling.
lecture_source: ORIE5260 Lecture 5, slides 9, 12–16, 26–27 and 36 (reference only; not a runtime input)

source_selection.rule: RL until ER has 36 consecutive observed monthly returns ending at least two months before the holding month, then ER permanently. Never choose source from current realized availability.

autocorrelation_hac: At return lag k, use k Bartlett HAC lags on calendar-spaced scores, with n/(n-2) correction and t(n-2) intervals.
